{{nihongo|'''Tomio Kubota'''|久保田 富雄|Kubota Tomio}} (6 December 1930 – 30 June 2020) was a Japanese [[mathematician]] working in [[number theory]]. His contributions include works on [[p-adic L function]]s and [[real-analytic]] [[automorphic form]]s.<ref>{{cite web |title=久保田富雄 |url=https://www.nippyo.co.jp/blogsusemi/keijiban/fuhou/ |publisher=nippyo.co |access-date=14 January 2021}}</ref>

His work on p-adic L-functions, later recognised as an aspect of [[Iwasawa theory]], was done jointly with [[Heinrich-Wolfgang Leopoldt|Leopoldt]].<ref>{{SpringerEOM|title=Iwasawa theory|access-date=26 February 2021}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=https://sites.math.washington.edu/~greenber/mem.html|title=Memories of Professor Iwasawa|author1-last=Greenberg|author1-first=Ralph|author1-link=Ralph Greenberg|accessdate=2 July 2018}}</ref>

He extended the concept of [[metaplectic group]], in a way significant for arithmetic applications.<ref>{{SpringerEOM|title=Shimura correspondence|access-date=26 February 2021}}</ref> This opened a field for later research on associated [[Dirichlet series]] and [[automorphic form]]s, and was a major step in the solution of [[Kummer sum|Kummer's conjecture]].<ref>Jeff Hoffstein, ''Eisenstein Series and Theta Functions on the Metaplectic Group'', pp. 73-78, in Maruti Ram Murty, ''Theta Functions: From the Classical to the Modern'' (1993).</ref>

==Works==
*''On automorphic functions and the reciprocity law in a number field''. [[Kinokuniya]], Tokyo 1969
*''Notes on analytic theory of numbers''. [[University of Chicago Press]], 1963
*with [[Sigekatu Kuroda]]: {{lang|ja|整数論 : 代数的整数論の基礎}}. ("Number Theory. Foundations of Algebraic Number Theory"), Asakura Shoten, Tokyo 1963
*[http://gdz.sub.uni-goettingen.de/dms/load/img/?PPN=GDZPPN002180499 Some arithmetical applications of an elliptic function, Journal für Reine und Angewandte Mathematik, Band 214/215, 1964/1965, 141-145]
*{{cite journal | author1-first = T. | author1-last = Kubota| author2-first=H.-W. | author2-last=Leopoldt | title= Eine p-adische Theorie der Zetawerte I: Einführung der p-adischen Dirichletschen L-Funktionen | journal = Journal für die Reine und Angewandte Mathematik |url=http://gdz.sub.uni-goettingen.de/dms/load/img/?PPN=PPN243919689_0214_0215&DMDID=DMDLOG_0029 | volume = 214/215 | year=1964 | pages=328–339}}
*{{cite book | first = Tomio | last = Kubota | title=Elementary theory of Eisenstein series |year = 1973|publisher=Kodansha, Tokyo / [[Wiley (publisher)|Wiley]], New York|isbn=978-0470509203}}
